order: a "App Store (opens the App Store listing)" (header) focus-visible=true

not_run: Tab stops after the first FAQ item (remaining FAQ items, FAQ answer links, final App Store button, footer links) were not pressed through; they follow DOM order and no element on the page sets a positive tabindex.
